'''Chituhr''' was a friendly nature spirit in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology that helped lead scouts and hunters to food. "Chituhr" was a popular name given to male Ewoks.<ref name="GCG" /> One of the [[Travelling Jindas]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] was also named [[Chituhr]].<ref name="Travelling">{{Ewoks|The Travelling Jindas}}</ref>
